source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Ohio State University Cooperative Extension, Sandusky County Family Nutrition Program

steps.instruction: Beat 12 large egg whites in a large mixing bowl until foamy.
Add 1 teaspoon of cream of tartar and beat until stiff, but not dry.
Gradually beat in 1 1/2 cups of sugar.
Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Gently fold in 1 cup of sifted flour.
Pour the batter into a 10-inch tube pan.
Bake for 75 minutes, until the top is nicely browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for an hour and fifteen minutes, or until the top is nicely browned.
